source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical rewrite first awaits PromiseCopyListener, uses copied.messageKeys[0], then awaits PromiseUrlListener for saveMessageToDisk before reading and comparing the saved file. Its dot fixture includes single-dot and dot-prefixed lines. The existing copy-listener lesson supplies the first completion contract; this patch adds the save boundary and whole fixture comparison. Fixed source later adds a stored-stream oracle and both store backends, which are not credited here. Bug comment2 is unavailable; no save test ran.
title: The save-message test waits for disk completion before reading its output
